questions.q: Two attackers face one defender. Tap where the right ala should be.
questions.explain: Yes. Wide in their own lane, one defender cannot cover both attackers.
choiceExplanations: Close together, one defender can guard you both at once.
Yes. Wide in their own lane, one defender cannot cover both attackers.
Behind the ball does not stretch the defender. We want to attack the goal together.

questions.q: How does this 2 against 1 work? Put the steps in order.
options: The defender steps toward the ball
Pass across to the right ala
questions.explain: Right. Carry to pull the defender in, pass past them, then attack the open space.
choiceExplanations: Right. Carry to pull the defender in, pass past them, then attack the open space.
The defender only steps in once you carry at them.
Pass only after the defender commits to you. Then the right ala is free.
The right ala carries forward last, into the space the defender left.

questions.q: Now the right ala carries and the defender steps toward them. Which pass beats the defender?
options: Pass across to the left ala
questions.explain: Yes. The defender stepped to the ball, so the left ala in the other lane is free.
choiceExplanations: That pass is safe, but it throws away the 2 against 1 we just built.
